fusions.name: Snarled Strands
fusions.desc: Whips the target twice with a lock of strands for 6 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and slowing it by 20% for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Shed in Their Eyes
fusions.desc: Shakes a cloud of shed fur over a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 11 damage to everything in it and stunning it for 0.8 seconds, with a 50% chance to leave each [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Combed Out
fusions.desc: Combs up to 3 conditions off you, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Caught in the Strands
fusions.desc: Against an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, your damage rises by 10%. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
